title: My e-reader highlighted a line I never wrote 📖
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:15 in the morning my e-reader highlighted a sentence I did not write.

scenes.narration: At 3:15 in the morning my e-reader highlighted a sentence I did not write.
I had no book open. It was only my notes file, empty since the day I bought it. One line, highlighted yellow. Do not read this aloud.
I read it aloud. Of course I did. In the silence of my flat, my own voice sounded like somebody else's.
The screen refreshed. A new line appeared, as if someone was typing, slowly, from the other side. Thank you. Now the wall can hear you.
Behind my bed, the wall gave a soft knock. Once. The way you knock when you recognise a voice.
The reader flickered. More lines. A whole page, appearing one by one. Every secret I had ever said out loud, alone, in the dark, thinking nobody was there.
The last highlighted line said, we kept all of them. And the next line was still being typed. My name, and underneath it, tomorrow's date.
So tell me. Do you keep reading, or throw it away?
